newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Defence, Commerce Ministers seen swapping.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Defence, Commerce Ministers seen swapping.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson is likely to appoint Industry and Commerce Minister Bjorn Von Sydow as Sweden's new defence minister, replacing Thage Peterson, Swedish daily Dagens Politik reported on Tuesday.
The daily's on-line pages said Peterson was likely to be given a position in Prime Minister Goran Persson's inner cabinet, replacing Leif Pagrotsky.

Pagrotsky would probably be offered the position of Industry and Commerce Minister, the first position with a government portfolio for a politician widely viewed as being a favourite of Persson's, the daily said.
